.ie \n(.g .ds Aq \(aq
.el .ds Aq '
.TH fnord 1  "fnord 0.1.2" 
.SH NAME
fnord \- A Discordian calendar and chaos utility
.SH SYNOPSIS
\fBfnord\fR [\fB\-\-config\fR] [\fB\-\-json\fR] [\fB\-\-no\-color\fR] [\fB\-\-no\-unicode\fR] [\fB\-h\fR|\fB\-\-help\fR] [\fB\-V\fR|\fB\-\-version\fR] [\fIsubcommands\fR]
.SH DESCRIPTION
fnord — All Hail Discordia!
.PP
A spiritual successor to ddate with a full suite of Discordian\-themed subcommands.
.PP
NAME
    fnord \- A Discordian calendar and chaos utility
.PP
DESCRIPTION
    All Hail Eris. All Hail Discordia.
    fnord weighs exactly 5 tons of flax.
.SH OPTIONS
.TP
\fB\-\-config\fR
Path to config file
.TP
\fB\-\-json\fR
Output JSON
.TP
\fB\-\-no\-color\fR
Disable color
.TP
\fB\-\-no\-unicode\fR
Disable unicode
.TP
\fB\-h\fR, \fB\-\-help\fR
Print help (see a summary with \*(Aq\-h\*(Aq)
.TP
\fB\-V\fR, \fB\-\-version\fR
Print version
.SH SUBCOMMANDS
.TP
fnord\-date(1)
Display today\*(Aqs (or a given) Discordian date
.TP
fnord\-cal(1)
Display a Discordian season calendar
.TP
fnord\-holyday(1)
Look up, list, add, or remove holydays
.TP
fnord\-moon(1)
Show the current moon phase
.TP
fnord\-omens(1)
Read the omens (weather + chaos report)
.TP
fnord\-fortune(1)
Dispense a Discordian fortune
.TP
fnord\-log(1)
Write in the Discordian grimoire
.TP
fnord\-wake(1)
Morning dashboard with ASCII\-art Discordian date
.TP
fnord\-pope(1)
Display your Discordian papal credentials
.TP
fnord\-pineal(1)
Report system consciousness status
.TP
fnord\-oracle(1)
Ask the oracle a question
.TP
fnord\-fnord(1)
Apply fnord redaction to text
.TP
fnord\-cabbage(1)
Count content in Discordian units
.TP
fnord\-chaos(1)
Shuffle lines, words, or characters
.TP
fnord\-law(1)
Search text and apply the Law of Fives
.TP
fnord\-pentabarf(1)
Validate text against the Five Commandments
.TP
fnord\-hotdog(1)
Determine whether a file is a hotdog
.TP
fnord\-erisian(1)
Diff two files as a theological dispute
.TP
fnord\-koan(1)
Dispense a Zen koan (Discordian edition)
.TP
fnord\-zodiac(1)
Display your zodiac sign
.TP
fnord\-help(1)
Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
.SH VERSION
v0.1.2
